item.title: Intercultural Relations in Digital and Unequal Worlds: Global South, non-WEIRD Contexts, and Methodological Frontiers
item.content:encoded:
This special issue focuses on intercultural relations in contemporary digital environments and unequal global contexts, with particular emphasis on the Global South and non-WEIRD (Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, Democratic) populations. The call seeks to expand scholarly understanding by centering research from and about regions often underrepresented in intercultural communication literature.

Appel publié par International Journal of Intercultural Relations. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
